title: Real returns, explained: why a 6.25% FD now earns you almost nothing
short: Real returns explained: why a 6.25% FD earns almost nothing
dek: With inflation at 6.09%, the interest on your deposit barely keeps up with prices. What real return means, how to calculate it, and how tax makes it negative.
card: SBI's one-year FD earned a real return of about 3.4% in January. With inflation at 6.09%, it is now 0.15%.
